name: frontend-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the frontend category in one install — UI/UX stacks, React, React Native, Vue 3, Next.js, Nuxt, Vite, Three.js, Inertia, Livewire, the generalist web worker, the craft layer (craft-layer), visual decisions (design-preview), shadcn staging (shadcn-studio), registry sourcing (registry-source), accessibility auditing, and skill auto-routing (skill-router). Uninstall cleanly with /frontend-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
